title: Secret handling
summary: An agent MUST check the repository-local `.env` file before it reports a needed secret as missing, MUST use a secret only for its authorized operation, and MUST NOT print, quote, persist, or expose a secret value.
instructions: Before an agent reports a needed secret as missing, it MUST check the repository-local `.env` file when that file exists.
An agent MUST use a secret only for its authorized operation.
An agent MUST NOT print, quote, persist, or expose a secret value.
